title: How To Forgive Someone Who Hurt You | A Prayer Of Forgiveness To Let It Go
description:
How to forgive someone who hurt you, with a prayer of forgiveness at the end.

Forgiving them doesn't mean it was fine, and it doesn't mean you have to trust them again. It means you hand the debt to God. Scripture on bitterness, seventy times seven, Joseph and the cross.

"Let all bitterness, and wrath, and anger, and clamour, and evil speaking, be put away from you, with all malice: And be ye kind one to another, tenderhearted, forgiving one another, even as God for Christ’s sake hath forgiven you." Ephesians 4:31-32 (KJV)

Scriptures in this video (KJV): Hebrews 12:15, Matthew 18:21-22, Romans 12:19, Luke 23:34, Ephesians 4:31-32, Psalm 103:12, Matthew 6:14-15, Genesis 50:20.

Type amen in the comments, and send this to a friend who needs it. Subscribe to Blessed Prayers for more.
